title: Creating a sling - series—Procedure, part 1: MedlinePlus Medical Encyclopedia
content: Creating a sling - series—Procedure, part 1 Go to slide 1 out of 2 Go to slide 2 out of 2 Overview To create a sling and swathe, begin with a triangular cloth or bandage draped under one arm and over the opposite shoulder.
